data.one_liner: A library to generate Gravatar URLs in Dart based on gravatar specs.
data.what_it_does: Simple Gravatar provides a utility class to compute MD5 hashes for email addresses and generate corresponding Gravatar image, QR code, and JSON profile URLs according to official specifications.
use_when: You need to display user avatars from Gravatar using email addresses.
You need to generate Gravatar QR code or JSON profile URLs.
avoid_when: You are not using Gravatar services for avatars.
You need a full-featured caching image widget rather than just URL generation.
strengths: Simple and straightforward API for generating different types of Gravatar URLs.
weaknesses: Limited functionality focused solely on URL generation.
Relies on external service availability for the actual images.
